title: Hollow hexagon
description: An online hard-surface mesh with a through-hole, angled sides and sharp corners. Draw on its top or turn it to reach another face.

title: Terrain patch
description: A smooth open heightfield for ridges and contour guides. This slower example uses the measured enclosure route.

title: Curved cylinder
description: A curved closed mesh for comparing flexible direction guidance and preserved guide paths. This slower example uses the recovered field route.

title: White toilet
description: The original plain SW_Toilet, decoded from its closed white mesh. A detailed curved test subject for surface guides; this mesh uses the general solver.
solverNotice: Guides steer fitted quad edge paths. Each result must pass surface, topology and quad-quality checks.
